# MachineLearningPotential

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A computational model trained on quantum mechanical data to predict interatomic forces and energies for molecular dynamics simulations. Enables accurate, large-scale atomistic simulations of materials like TaN, which are critical for designing nanoscale interconnects and neuromorphic devices.
